definition_en: used before a noun that the listener can already identify

examples.supportive: Please close the door I opened a minute ago.
examples.neutral: The teacher walked into the room.

items: Give me ____ book you were reading.
She sat on ____ chair near her desk.
I want to open ____ window in my room.
he_interference_note: ה׳ הידיעה בעברית נצמדת למילה עצמה, ובאנגלית היא מילה נפרדת שעומדת לפני שם העצם ולפני שם התואר שלו.

definition_en: to exist, or to have a particular quality or position

examples.supportive: I want to be a doctor when I finish school.

items: She wants to ____ a teacher one day.
This will ____ easy for you.
They should ____ here early tomorrow.
he_interference_note: בעברית משפט בהווה נכתב בלי פועל ("הוא מורה"), ולכן דוברי עברית משמיטים את be באנגלית.

definition_en: belonging to or connected with someone or something

examples.supportive: The door of the car was open all night.
examples.neutral: He is the leader of that group.

items: She is the mother ____ my best friend.
This is the end ____ our story.
He knows the name ____ every student here.
he_interference_note: בעברית סדר המילים הוא "הדלת של המכונית"; באנגלית אפשר גם "the car's door", ודוברי עברית נוטים להעדיף תמיד of.

definition_en: used to show that something is part of a larger group or amount

examples.supportive: Some of the students in my class are new here.

items: Many ____ these books are old.
Half ____ the class went home early.
None ____ my friends could come.

definition_en: used to join two words, phrases or clauses

examples.supportive: I bought bread and milk at the shop this morning.

items: He opened the door ____ walked outside.
We need paper ____ a pen.
She is kind ____ very smart.

definition_en: showing the place or person that something moves towards

examples.supportive: She walked to the window and looked outside.
examples.neutral: He sent it to his brother.

items: We are going ____ the sea this week.
Please give this letter ____ your teacher.
He walked ____ school without me.
he_interference_note: האות ל־ בעברית משמשת גם לכיוון וגם למקבל הפעולה, ולכן דוברי עברית מבלבלים בין to לבין for.

definition_en: used before a noun to show it is one that has not been mentioned before

examples.supportive: I saw a dog in the garden this morning.

items: He wants to buy ____ new car.
There is ____ letter for you on the table.
She works in ____ big office near here.
he_interference_note: בעברית אין תווית ליחיד לא מיודע, ולכן דוברי עברית משמיטים את a לפני שם עצם יחיד ("he is teacher").

definition_en: inside something, or surrounded by it

examples.supportive: The keys are in my bag on the table.
examples.neutral: She works in a small office.

items: He left his coat ____ the car.
There is milk ____ the bottle.
She lives ____ a quiet street.
he_interference_note: האות ב־ בעברית מכסה in, at ו-on, ולכן דוברי עברית בוחרים ביניהן כמעט באקראי.

definition_en: to own something, or to hold it as yours

examples.supportive: I have a brother and a sister at home.

items: We ____ enough money for the trip.
Do you ____ any questions about this?
They ____ many friends in this city.
he_interference_note: בעברית אומרים "יש לי ספר" בלי פועל שייכות, ולכן דוברי עברית כותבים "to me there is a book" במקום I have a book.

definition_en: to eat or drink something

examples.supportive: We always have breakfast before we leave for work.
examples.neutral: They have lunch together every day.

items: Let us ____ dinner together tonight.
I usually ____ coffee in the morning.
Would you like to ____ some tea?
he_interference_note: בעברית אומרים "לאכול ארוחת בוקר", ולכן דוברי עברית כותבים "eat breakfast" במקום have breakfast.

definition_en: the thing or animal that was just mentioned

examples.supportive: I found your phone and put it on the desk.

items: I like this book because ____ is very funny.
The box is heavy, so please carry ____ with care.
She opened the letter and read ____ slowly.
he_interference_note: בעברית משפט מזג אוויר נכתב בלי נושא ("יורד גשם"), ולכן דוברי עברית משמיטים את it ב-"it is raining".

definition_en: the person or people the speaker is talking to

examples.supportive: Can you help me carry these heavy boxes?

items: I will call ____ when I get home.
Do ____ know where my keys are?
She wants ____ to come early tomorrow.
he_interference_note: בעברית יש צורת זכר ונקבה ויחיד ורבים לגוף שני; באנגלית you מכסה את כולן, ודוברי עברית מחפשים צורה נפרדת לרבים.

definition_en: showing who will get something or why it is done

examples.supportive: I bought this gift for my sister.

items: She made a cake ____ her friends.
I am saving money ____ a new car.
He wrote a song ____ his mother.

definition_en: used to show how long something continues

examples.supportive: We waited for an hour outside the station.
examples.neutral: He worked there for many years.

items: She has lived here ____ many years.
They talked ____ a long time.
I will be away ____ a week.

definition_en: used to make a word or sentence negative

examples.supportive: I am not ready to leave yet.

items: He is ____ at home right now.
They will ____ come to the party.
I do ____ understand this question.

definition_en: used to point to a person or thing further away from the speaker

examples.supportive: Look at that house on the other side of the street.

items: I do not like ____ picture on the wall.
Who is ____ man near the door?
Please pass me ____ box over there.

definition_en: used to introduce a clause after verbs such as say, know or think

examples.supportive: She said that she would come home early tonight.
examples.neutral: I think that he is right.

items: He knows ____ we are waiting for him.
I hope ____ you feel better soon.
She told me ____ the shop was closed.
he_interference_note: בעברית ש־ נצמדת למילה הבאה אחריה; באנגלית that היא מילה נפרדת, ודוברי עברית משמיטים אותה.

definition_en: touching and supported by the top surface of something

examples.supportive: Your keys are on the table next to the door.
examples.neutral: He put it on the box.

items: She left her bag ____ the floor.
There is a picture ____ the wall.
Please put your name ____ this paper.

definition_en: having something as its subject

examples.supportive: She wrote a book on modern art.
examples.neutral: This is a report on the problem.

items: He gave a talk ____ climate change.
I read an article ____ health and food.
They need more information ____ this subject.

definition_en: in the company of someone or something

examples.supportive: She went to the park with her friends.

items: I want to travel ____ you next summer.
She plays football ____ her brother.
Come ____ me to the shop.

definition_en: using a particular tool or thing

examples.supportive: He cut the bread with a sharp knife.
examples.neutral: She wrote it with a pen.

items: Please open the bottle ____ this tool.
You can clean the window ____ warm water.
He fixed the chair ____ his own hands.
he_interference_note: בעברית ב־ מכסה גם "עם" וגם "באמצעות", ולכן דוברי עברית כותבים by a knife במקום with a knife.

definition_en: to perform an action or piece of work

examples.supportive: I always do my school work before dinner.

items: We ____ the dishes after every meal.
Please ____ not open that window.
They will ____ the work tomorrow.
he_interference_note: בעברית "לעשות" מכסה גם do וגם make, ולכן דוברי עברית כותבים "do a mistake" במקום make a mistake.

definition_en: in the job or role of something

examples.supportive: She works as a nurse in the city hospital.
examples.neutral: He is known as a good teacher.

items: He started ____ a driver many years ago.
They chose her ____ their new leader.
I used the box ____ a table.

definition_en: at the same time that something else happens

examples.supportive: As I opened the door, the phone started to ring.
examples.neutral: As we walked, he talked about his job.

items: ____ the sun went down, it became cold.
She sang ____ she worked in the garden.
____ we drove home, the rain stopped.

definition_en: the male person or animal that was just mentioned

examples.supportive: My brother called me because he needed help.

items: I met your father and ____ was very kind.
When the doctor came, ____ asked many questions.
My friend is late because ____ missed the bus.

definition_en: the speaker together with at least one other person

examples.supportive: My sister and I are late because we missed the bus.

items: My friends and I hope ____ will win.
If you come early, ____ can eat together.
Our team is strong, so ____ should not worry.

definition_en: used to point to a person or thing that is near the speaker

examples.supportive: This book in my hand is the one I told you about.

items: I really like ____ picture near the window.
Who left ____ bag on my chair?
Please read ____ letter before you leave.

definition_en: in a particular place

examples.supportive: I will wait for you at the station near the park.

items: They met ____ the shop this morning.
He is ____ home with his family.
We stopped ____ a small hotel.

definition_en: used before a point in time

examples.supportive: We always eat at the same time every evening.
examples.neutral: She called me at that moment.

items: The film starts ____ night, not in the morning.
We will meet ____ lunch time tomorrow.
He wakes up ____ the same time each day.

definition_en: the people, animals or things that were just mentioned

examples.supportive: My parents are away because they went to the sea.

items: The students are quiet because ____ are reading.
I called my friends but ____ did not answer.
The shops close early, so ____ are closed now.

definition_en: used to introduce something that is different or surprising

examples.supportive: I wanted to come, but I was too tired.
examples.neutral: She is young but very strong.

items: He tried hard, ____ he did not win.
The room is small ____ very clean.
I called her, ____ she did not answer.

definition_en: showing the place or time where something starts

examples.supportive: She walked home from the shop in the rain.
examples.neutral: This letter is from my sister.

items: He came ____ a small village near the sea.
The bus leaves ____ this street every hour.
I learned it ____ my father.
he_interference_note: ההיפוך form/from הוא שגיאת כתיב נפוצה מאוד אצל דוברי עברית, שקוראים אנגלית מהר משמאל לימין.

definition_en: showing who or what does the action in a passive sentence

examples.supportive: This book was written by a young teacher.
examples.neutral: The work was done by hand.

items: The window was broken ____ a heavy ball.
That song was sung ____ my sister.
The room was cleaned ____ the students.

definition_en: next to or very near something

examples.supportive: She sat by the window and watched the rain.

items: The dog sleeps ____ the warm fire.
We stopped ____ a small river.
Please stand ____ me in the picture.

definition_en: used to show that something is going to happen in the future

examples.supportive: I will call you tomorrow after I finish work.

items: They ____ arrive before dinner.
He ____ not come to the meeting.
We ____ know the answer next week.
he_interference_note: בעברית העתיד מסומן בתוך הפועל עצמו ("אקרא"), ולכן דוברי עברית שוכחים את מילת העזר will.

definition_en: used to join two choices when only one is possible

examples.supportive: You can have tea or coffee with your cake.
examples.neutral: We will go today or tomorrow.

items: Do you want bread ____ rice?
She will travel by bus ____ by train.
Come early ____ stay at home.

definition_en: belonging to the male person who was just mentioned

examples.supportive: My brother lost his keys somewhere in the garden.

items: The boy opened ____ book and started to read.
My father parked ____ car near the shop.
He gave me ____ phone number.

definition_en: to speak words in order to express something

examples.supportive: Please say your name slowly so I can write it.
examples.neutral: They always say the same thing.

items: What did she ____ about the plan?
Do not ____ anything to my parents.
He did not ____ a word all evening.
he_interference_note: בעברית "אמר לי" ו"סיפר לי" קרובים מאוד, ולכן דוברי עברית כותבים "he said me" במקום he told me.

definition_en: to move or travel from one place to another

examples.supportive: We go to the park every week in summer.

items: I want to ____ home early tonight.
They will ____ by train next week.
Do not ____ outside without a coat.
he_interference_note: בעברית "ללכת" מכסה גם go וגם walk, ולכן דוברי עברית כותבים "I went by foot" במקום I walked.

definition_en: the female person or animal that was just mentioned

examples.supportive: My sister called me because she needed a ride.

items: I asked my mother and ____ said yes.
The teacher is busy because ____ is writing a report.
My friend is happy because ____ found a job.

definition_en: to a very great degree

examples.supportive: The bag was so heavy that I could not carry it.

items: This room is ____ cold tonight.
He drove ____ fast that we felt afraid.
The film was ____ long.

definition_en: for that reason

examples.supportive: It started to rain, so we went back home.
examples.neutral: He was late, so he took a taxi.

items: The shop was closed, ____ I came back later.
She felt tired, ____ she went to bed.
We had no money, ____ we walked.

definition_en: the whole number or amount of something

examples.supportive: All the students in my class passed the test.

items: She read ____ the books on that shelf.
We spent ____ our money in one day.
He works ____ week without a break.

definition_en: on the subject of someone or something

examples.supportive: We talked about the new plan for an hour.
examples.neutral: This film is about a young doctor.

items: She wrote a letter ____ her trip.
I know nothing ____ this subject.
They asked me ____ my family.

definition_en: a little more or a little less than a number

examples.supportive: About half of the class came early today.

items: The trip takes ____ half a day by car.
We waited ____ an hour outside the station.
He is ____ as tall as his father.

definition_en: used to say that one thing depends on another

examples.supportive: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
examples.neutral: Ask her if you need help.

items: ____ you come early, we can eat together.
I will call you ____ the shop is open.
She will be happy ____ we visit her.

definition_en: the number that comes before two in counting

examples.supportive: I have only one brother and no sisters.

items: He ate ____ piece of bread and drank some water.
Only ____ student answered the question.
We stayed there for ____ week.

definition_en: belonging to the person who is speaking

examples.supportive: I left my bag on the chair near the door.

items: I lost ____ keys somewhere in the house.
This is ____ best book.
Please give ____ letter to the teacher.

definition_en: to have information about something in your mind

examples.supportive: I know the answer because I read the whole book.

items: Do you ____ where the station is?
She does not ____ his phone number.
We ____ that the shop closes early today.
he_interference_note: בעברית "לדעת" מכסה גם know בעובדות וגם know בהיכרות עם אדם; באנגלית ההיכרות היא know בלבד, לא "learn".

definition_en: to be familiar with a person or place

examples.supportive: I know your sister because we studied together.
examples.neutral: She does not know this city.

items: Do you ____ the family next door?
He does not ____ many people here.
We ____ each other from school.
he_interference_note: דוברי עברית משתמשים ב-meet במקום know כדי לתאר היכרות קיימת ("I met him for years").

definition_en: in or at that place

examples.supportive: Put the box on that table and leave it there.

items: We went to the beach and stayed ____ all day.
The shop is closed, so do not go ____ now.
I left my coat ____ last night.

definition_en: used with be to say that something exists

examples.supportive: There is a large garden behind my house.

items: ____ is no milk in the bottle.
____ are many students in this class.
Is ____ a shop near the station?
he_interference_note: בעברית אומרים "יש ספר על השולחן" בלי מילת נושא, ולכן דוברי עברית משמיטים את there ב-there is.

definition_en: used to ask about one thing out of a limited group

examples.supportive: Which book do you want, the red one or the blue one?

items: ____ bus goes to the city?
I do not know ____ road to take.
____ of these bags is yours?

definition_en: to be able to do something

examples.supportive: She can read a whole book in one evening.

items: He ____ speak many languages.
We ____ not open this door.
____ you help me for a minute?
he_interference_note: בעברית "יכול" מקבל צורת זכר ונקבה ורבים; באנגלית can אינו משתנה, ודוברי עברית מוסיפים לו s.

definition_en: a closed metal container for food or drink

examples.supportive: He opened a can of cold drink and shared it.
examples.neutral: She bought a can at the shop.

items: I need an empty metal ____ for this.
There is one ____ of fish left.
Please put the used ____ in the box.

definition_en: to receive or obtain something

examples.supportive: I hope to get a letter from my sister this week.

items: Did you ____ my message last night?
He wants to ____ a better job.
We ____ our books at the start of the year.

definition_en: to arrive at a place

examples.supportive: We get to school early every morning without a car.

items: What time did you ____ home last night?
She will ____ to the station before dinner.
They ____ to work early every day.
he_interference_note: דוברי עברית משתמשים ב-arrive בכל מקרה; באנגלית מדוברת get to הוא הצורה הרגילה.

definition_en: belonging to the female person who was just mentioned

examples.supportive: My sister lost her phone somewhere in the house.

items: The girl opened ____ book and started to read.
My mother parked ____ car near the shop.
She gave me ____ phone number.

definition_en: used to talk about something that is possible but not real

examples.supportive: If I had more money, I would travel around the world.

items: I ____ buy that car if it were cheaper.
He ____ help you if you asked him.
They ____ come, but they are too busy.
he_interference_note: בעברית התנאי הבלתי קיים נבנה עם "היה" ("הייתי נוסע"), ולכן דוברי עברית כותבים "I was travel" במקום I would travel.

definition_en: to have an opinion or belief about something

examples.supportive: I think this plan is better than the old one.

items: What do you ____ about my idea?
She does not ____ he is right.
We ____ the shop is closed today.
